    FEATURED ARTICLE

    SAMPLE INTERACTIVE TOOL

    AI Readiness 360

    Explore how a readiness score can be calculated with clear, reviewable rules.

    Demonstration only: five sample questions, each worth 20 points. This is not a validated professional or organizational readiness assessment.

    Your Assessment

    One choice per question. Scores are based on the maturity level of the selected response.

    How scoring works

    Each answer has a value of 0, 5, 10, 15 or 20 points. Five questions total 100 possible points. Your score is the sum of all five answers.
